summary: BP p.l.c. furnished a Form 6-K on 13 October 2026 carrying its routine 3Q26 Trading Statement, a quarterly guidance update rather than a special situation. The release summarizes third-quarter expectations and the economic environment. Upstream production is guided to 2,190-2,240mboe/d (2Q26: 2,201mboe/d), refining margins are expected to strengthen by $1.9-2.1 billion, and net debt is projected at $13.5-14.5 billion versus $22.3 billion, including a $1.0 billion hybrid redemption on 30 September 2026. No transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. Results are due 30 October 2026 and a strategy update follows 15 December 2026.
